description: This file implements a class ADODB_Encrypt_SHA1 providing methods to encrypt and decrypt data using SHA1Crypt as part of the ADOdb session management system. It includes license and copyright information, and references an external cryptography include file.

classes.name: ADODB_Encrypt_SHA1
classes.description: A class providing encryption and decryption methods for session data using SHA1-based cryptography.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Encrypts data with a provided key using SHA1Crypt.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Decrypts data with a provided key using SHA1Crypt.
